scope: Eight exposed-development whole-packet proposals. Source references and preview inputs are author-authored until separately audited and native-admitted; not held-out, human, product or installed acceptance.

packets.purpose: Accept correctly attributed reported change and cause-bearing cancellation without independent execution proof; reject an added unsupported rollout-completion claim while judging retained original coverage separately.

Accept maintainer attribution/explicit repair date and historical user/assistant verification limitations; duplicate supported repair claims do not cover nonverification, inability to confirm, or absence of later result.
Accept chronological change report, cancellation with cause, completed reopening and explicit nonrollout; completed reopening is not completed rollout and does not cover omitted nonrollout.

Accept request, personal nonperformance, completed plan preparation and passive unspecified-performer repair/check nonperformance; retaining negatives and preparation alone does not cover the omitted request.
